claims.statement: For 1<=k<=3, positive a_i dividing b, inserting all height-one points of the positive orthant in N={d in Z^k: b divides sum a_i d_i} by successive star subdivisions yields regular simplicial cones whose primitive vertical generators have height one.
hypotheses: a_i and b are positive integers
regularity is measured in the congruence lattice N
claims.supported_scope: All stated coefficients and common multiples in vertical dimension at most three; not just the finite local example.

novelty.explanation: Expanded reconstruction of the same empty-simplex argument in the reference manuscript; no originality or priority claim.

claims.attribution: Old Argus derivation, model_derivation.md:48-90; manuscript prop:marked-monomial-reduction, proof; elementary lattice reasoning.

tools_and_replays: Read the complete decisive proof and corresponding manuscript proof.
Compared the old source and archive member to the existing manifest; no universal computation substituted for the proof.
limitations: No globalization, MMP-existence or main-theorem certificate.
No novelty search was needed because no novelty is claimed.
